name: ATK_QB_CONTEXTS_ALL_B
description: Base table for all context objects, which can be either Rule Context or Query Context.

columns.name: CONTEXT_ID
columns.description: Primary key of the table.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Represents the application to which the context object belongs to.

columns.name: CONTEXT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the context object. This name is used for fetching queries, fetching the rule results etc.

columns.name: MULTI_VALUE_FLAG
columns.description: Represents whether there is conditional dependency among the results that are to be returned when a rule matches.

columns.name: MULTI_RULE_RESULT_FLAG
columns.description: Represents whether to return the result of first matching rule or the results of all the matching rules

columns.name: CONTEXT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: This column is used to identify whether the context object is used for creating the rules or setting up queries. The current values to be assigned are "RULES" and "QUERY"

columns.name: FLEX_FIELD_NAME
columns.description: If one result value depends on another value then we use the DFF. This field represents the name of the DFF.

columns.name: FLEX_FIELD_APP_ID
columns.description: Represents the application to which the DFF belongs to.

columns.name: USE_DEFAULT_FLAG
columns.description: Determines whether to use the default result if no rule matches.

columns.name: IS_DEFAULT_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.description: Determines whether the default value is mandatory or not.

columns.name: CONTEXT_CATEGORY
columns.description: This column is used to prevent the context name clashes.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: IS_QUERY_USER_NAME_UNIQUE
columns.description: Flag to restrict the user to create rules or queries with unique user name under a rule or query group.

columns.name: UNIQUE_QRY_USER_NAME_REQ_MSG
columns.description: Error message raised when creating query or rule with existing user name under a query group or rule group.

columns.name: IS_QRY_CRITERIA_REQ
columns.description: Flag to restrict the user to create rules with atleast one criteria or condition.

columns.name: QRY_CRITERIA_REQ_MSG
columns.description: Error message raised when trying to create query or rule without condition or criteria.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
